classes.DERIVED_SCREENING: Calculated from declared inputs with a transparent low-order equation; useful for consistency only.
classes.DESIGN_TARGET: Program choice or constraint to optimize toward; not a prediction.
classes.EXPERIMENT_DEPENDENT: Cannot be promoted to operational fact without physical validation.
classes.PHYSICAL_CONSTANT: Exact or accepted physical constant used in arithmetic.
classes.REFERENCE_INFORMED_TARGET: Engineering target selected using published contemporary reactor concepts; not achieved by SFR-1 unless separately validated.
classes.SOLVER_DEPENDENT: Must be produced by a named high-authority solver/analysis before promotion.

parameters.note: 8 m scale is comparable to the 2026 Helios preconcept; SFR-1 must re-optimize scale.
Sets Rev A aspect ratio; not a solved plasma boundary.
6 T is a contemporary high-field power-plant reference point, not a demonstrated SFR-1 field.
3% is deliberately conservative near the 2.7% Helios preconcept value; finite-beta stability remains solver-dependent.
1 GW fusion class is a sizing target only.
20 K HTS operation is used in Helios and is technologically plausible, but SFR-1 cryogenic margin is unvalidated.
20 T is treated as a design ceiling, not a claimed SFR-1 coil result.
0.4% ceiling follows contemporary reactor coil engineering practice; detailed REBCO stack limits must come from conductor-specific data and FEA.
Reserves radial space for blanket/shield/vessel/thermal isolation; OpenMC and coil optimization may force growth.
Margin above unity is required; full 3-D TBR including penetrations remains solver-dependent.
10 MW/m2 is an engineering target used in contemporary divertor studies; SFR-1 edge power exhaust is unvalidated.
Near first-harmonic electron cyclotron frequency for a 6 T reference field; ray tracing determines actual launch/resonance strategy.
Used only for a preliminary plant ledger until full neutronics exists.
SIMSOPT/coil optimization plus structural FEA and HTS strain.
3-D OpenMC/DAGMC or equivalent including ports and streaming.
No physical reactor hardware is validated by this repository.

policy: Every numeric parameter is explicitly classified. A design target is not a predicted or validated performance value.
